name: browser-workflow-skill-builder
tagline_zh: 把LinkedIn、X、YouTube这些难搞的登录网站，变成你随手可用的自动化技能。存页面、写脚本、截图验证。
tagline_en: Turn tough logged-in sites like LinkedIn, X, YouTube into reusable automation skills. Save context, script.
desc_en: Create robust browser automation skills for sites like LinkedIn, X/Twitter, YouTube, Stripe, or other logged-in web apps by saving page context, analyzing HTML/CSS, writing skill-local JS extract/verify scripts, and using CSS selector actions with screenshot verification.
why_zh: 同类工具只录点击，它却会读HTML、写本地脚本，并用截图验证每一步，专治登录态和动态页面。
why_en: Unlike record-click tools, it analyzes HTML, writes local scripts, and verifies via screenshots—built for logged-in and dynamic.
